item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://cableteque.com/blog/retiring-estimator-quoting-knowledge","version_id":"7684d3f81b48f399e04d30dd15d5c9125d3b3466ed41c07228ed6dc7b4631cc7","decision":"accept","reason":"This dated, quotable commercial item is directly relevant to manufacturing design: Cableteque says its quoting system captures estimator knowledge by checking connector-and-wire compatibility, mapping part numbers, comparing distributor pricing, and filling labor templates. Its reported 60–80% automatic labor completion and Derrick Lang’s claimed 70% turnaround reduction are vendor/customer-attributed claims, not proof of accuracy or deployed performance; verification would require disclosed RFQ samples, error rates, attempt conditions, and comparison against estimator-reviewed quotes. It adds a commercial perspective on AI-assisted manufacturability and quoting decisions, while the stated compatibility checks support only the narrower claim that the system performs those checks.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
